race.verdict: In a wide-open sprint, it could be worth taking a chance on FRANTIC in first-time blinkers. Course winners Jenever and King's Crown are feared most, with Simba's Pride and Go Victor others to consider. FRANTIC JENEVER KING'S CROWN (IRE)
